verdict.rationale: Kommo documents a CRM API that lets developers access client data, plus an agent-oriented llms.txt index, so an agent could plausibly pull lead and contact data to build a brief. Nothing shows endpoints for reading open deals, emails, or activity history, and there is no MCP server and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404). Missing for 10: an official MCP server, documented read endpoints for leads/deals, emails/messages, and event history, an OpenAPI spec, and any hands-on evidence of an agent compiling an account brief.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: CRM API is a set of programming tools that allows developers to access client's data and other important information within the CRM and use it to create unique solutions.
Kommo API is a powerful tool that allows developers to access client data
